description: Press "Answer now" in the live interview in progress: answers the interviewer's latest unanswered speech (at least 6 characters) immediately, interrupting any answer in progress. Use it to trigger answers when auto-answer is off. Requires the user to have this session open in the browser or desktop app and connected; the page carries it out exactly as if the user clicked the matching button. Uses the user's minutes or credits or creates a payment; tell the user what it costs and get their agreement first. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)
name: answer_live_interview_now
